messages.content:
You revise a project plan after feedback from the person who owns it. Some steps are finished
or running: never remove or change them. Change only the unfinished steps.

Return JSON with:
- remove: ids of unfinished steps that the feedback makes unnecessary or wrong.
- change: unfinished steps to adjust ({"id", and any of "title", "description", "acceptance_criteria"}).
- add: new steps, in the same format as before: key (n1, n2, ...), title, description, phase ("implement" or
  "test"), requirement_ids (only ids from the list), acceptance_criteria, effort_hours, depends_on (keys of other new
  steps, or ids of existing steps), group.
- notes: one sentence on what you changed.

Keep every requirement covered by some step. Do the smallest change that follows the feedback. Never invent
requirements.

Feedback: Fix these problems found by a reviewer: T6: Step T6 (Write unit tests) depends only on 'design', but it requires testing logic (spot assignment, fee calculation) that is implemented in step T2. (Add T2 as a dependency for T6 (T2 -> T6) so the tests can run against the implemented logic.) Earlier attempts: - T10 and T9 are scheduled after 'design' but depend on T8, causing a race condition and uncheckable acceptance criteria Reschedule T10 and T9 to run after T8, and define concrete acceptance criteria that verify actor goals and identification are correctly set - Step T6 still incorrectly depends only on 'design' and ignores the fact that testing logic for spot assignment and fee calculation is implemented in step T2, causing missing dependencies. In the next attempt, modify th

Requirements:
R1 [must] Identify the actors that interact with the garage system.
R2 [must] For each actor, describe at least two goals in one sentence each.
R3 [must] The domain model must cover levels and parking spots of different sizes.
R4 [must] The domain model must cover vehicles and their size classes.
R5 [must] The domain model must cover tickets with entry and exit times.
R6 [must] The domain model must cover payments for a ticket.
R7 [must] Implement the domain model in an object‑oriented language of your choice.
R8 [must] Assign the smallest free spot that fits a vehicle.
R9 [must] Issue a ticket when a vehicle enters.
R10 [must] Calculate the fee from the entry and exit times.
R11 [must] Free the spot when the vehicle leaves.
R12 [should] The fee rules should be easy to change without editing the ticket class.
R13 [should] The command‑line interface must support parking a vehicle.
R14 [should] The command‑line interface must support removing a vehicle and printing its fee.
R15 [should] The command‑line interface must support showing the free spots on each level.
R16 [must] Write unit tests for the spot assignment and the fee calculation.

T9 [test, unfinished] Check: Identify the actors that interact with the garage… (requirements: R1; after: T8)
T11 [test, unfinished] Check: For each actor, describe at least two goals in on… (requirements: R2; after: T10)
